title: apply_style_preset inputSchema
description: Argument shape for apply_style_preset. x-honua-reference-shape: this shape tracks the reference implementation (advertised name honua_apply_style_preset), which applies a reusable StyleRef preset (a catalog styleId) as the primary/default style of a published layer, persisting through the server OGC API – Styles authoring surface (ADR-0048) so subsequent render_map calls reflect it. The bare taxonomy responsibility (map-package composition) is described in taxonomy.md §Map composition; the reference implementation binds presets to published layers rather than to an in-memory MapPackage. Applying a preset never edits feature records (ADR-0028); it authors presentation metadata on the hosted service. See taxonomy.md §Map composition and resources.md §honua://styles.

serviceId.description: Published service identifier or name whose layer is being styled.

layerId.description: Service-local layer index to apply the preset to.

styleId.description: StyleRef preset identifier (style_…) to apply as the layer's primary/default style. Discover the available presets with get_style (no styleId lists honua://styles).
